brief:
An Israeli drone struck a shelter in Gaza, wounding six Palestinians including two children, according to local sources cited by Middle East Eye. The attack took place despite an active ceasefire between Israeli and Palestinian forces.

The incident represents a breach of the truce, with two of the six wounded being minors caught in the strike on the civilian facility.
dek: Israeli drone hits Gaza shelter as attacks wound six Palestinians despite ceasefire Two children are among six Palestinians wounded in fresh Israeli attacks in Gaza despite the ceasefire, according to local sources cited by the official Wafa news agency.
title: Israeli drone strikes Gaza shelter, wounding six Palestinians during ceasefire
